not_measurable_gold_blind.r3_family_semantic_correctness: Route semantic correctness cannot be scored without gold comparison; Wave 4 provides structural and cross-boundary evidence only, per Phase C contract.

legacy_route_predictions.explanation: Older frozen predictions carry display labels only; structured_routes did not exist at freeze time. No routes were minted for these predictions; the adapter observes them fail-closed without synthesis.

known_product_ceilings.heading_rescue: Heading-context rescue requires verbatim single-line claim match in the referenced source document; ambiguous or non-identity headings fail closed to no target.
known_product_ceilings.evidence_binding_fallback: When a service record carries no source_url, all E-DISC evidence refs are bound (documented fallback ceiling from Phase A).
known_product_ceilings.table_rows: Table rows remain exclusively under the Wave 3 header-identity gate; the Wave 4 rescue never mints targets from them.
